newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa invests $20 mln in coal injection.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa invests $20 mln in coal injection.

text.p: Steelmaker Ahmsa will invest $20 million on coal-injection systems for its blast furnaces 3 and 4.

"The company has awarded Clyde Pneumatic Conveying a new contract to develop two similar coal-injection systems in its blast furnaces 3 and 4, which entails an additional investment of $20 million," Ahmsa said in a statement on Tuesday.
Ahmsa has already spent $20 million on a coal-injection system at blast furnace 5, which is due to enter service in December.
Work on furnaces 3 and 4 is scheduled to begin in February 1997.
Ahmsa added that coal for the new systems would be provided by its sister company Minerales Monclova.
